answer: Random witness quorum: each new account must escrow 3 POA with each of 3 established witnesses drawn by hash from the 5,000 oldest accounts, locked for 25 epochs. An honest newcomer locks 9 POA once; 1,000 fakes lock 9,000 POA and need 3,000 witness slots. An attacker who owns 50 witnesses rarely gets all three seats, since (50/5,000)^3 is one in a million per draw, and rings drawn as witnesses get no cedar-like shelter from review. Witnesses must sign a plume of audit questions; fakes later flagged by 5% crystal-clear spot checks cost every witness 50% of the escrow.
